# fmc_access_control_policy_logging (Resource)

This resource manages Access Control Policy Logging Settings.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "fmc_access_control_policy_logging" "example" {
  access_control_policy_id                = "76d24097-41c4-4558-a4d0-a8c07ac08470"
  syslog_alert_id                         = "35e197ca-33a8-11ef-b2d1-d98ae17766e7"
  syslog_use_platform_settings            = true
  syslog_platform_settings_severity       = "CRIT"
  ips_events_send_syslog                  = true
  ips_events_syslog_severity              = "ERR"
  ips_events_syslog_alert_id              = "35e197ca-33a8-11ef-b2d1-d98ae17766e7"
  file_and_malware_events_send_syslog     = true
  file_and_malware_events_syslog_severity = "ALERT"
  file_and_malware_events_syslog_alert_id = "35e197ca-33a8-11ef-b2d1-d98ae17766e7"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `access_control_policy_id` (String) Id of the Access Control Policy.

### Optional

- `domain` (String) Name of the FMC domain
- `file_and_malware_events_send_syslog` (Boolean) Send syslog messages for file and malware events.
- `file_and_malware_events_syslog_alert_id` (String) Id of the syslog alert used for file and malware events. If not set, the default syslog alert (`syslog_alert_id`) is used.
- `file_and_malware_events_syslog_severity` (String) Severity of syslog messages for file and malware events.
  - Choices: `ALERT`, `CRIT`, `DEBUG`, `EMERG`, `ERR`, `INFO`, `NOTICE`, `WARNING`
- `ips_events_send_syslog` (Boolean) Send syslog messages for IPS events.
- `ips_events_syslog_alert_id` (String) Id of the syslog alert used for IPS events. If not set, the default syslog alert (`syslog_alert_id`) is used.
- `ips_events_syslog_severity` (String) Severity of syslog messages for IPS events.
  - Choices: `ALERT`, `CRIT`, `DEBUG`, `EMERG`, `ERR`, `INFO`, `NOTICE`, `WARNING`
- `syslog_alert_id` (String) Id of the default syslog alert used for connection events of this Access Control Policy.
- `syslog_platform_settings_severity` (String) Severity of syslog messages sent using the syslog configuration from FTD Platform Settings.
  - Choices: `ALERT`, `CRIT`, `DEBUG`, `EMERG`, `ERR`, `INFO`, `NOTICE`, `WARNING`
- `syslog_use_platform_settings` (Boolean) Send syslog messages using the syslog configuration from FTD Platform Settings.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Id of the object
- `type` (String) Type of the object; this value is always 'LoggingSetting'.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# <domain> is optional. If not provided, `Global` is used implicitly and resource's `domain` attribute is not set.
terraform import fmc_access_control_policy_logging.example "<domain>,<access_control_policy_id>,<id>"
```
